mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_work WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'pending') AS pendingWorks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_work WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'pending' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS newPending7, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_work WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'pending' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS newPendingPrev, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_work WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'on_shelf') AS listedWorks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_work WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'on_shelf' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS newListed7, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_work WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'on_shelf' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS newListedPrev, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount),0) FROM sys_order WHERE status = 'completed' AND DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m')) AS monthTrade, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount),0) FROM sys_order WHERE status = 'completed' AND DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),'%Y-%m')) AS prevMonthTrade, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) FROM sys_logininfor WHERE login_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS activeUsers, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) FROM sys_logininfor WHERE login_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND login_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS prevActiveUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_order WHERE status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled')) AS pendingOrders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_real_name_auth WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS pendingUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_report WHERE status = 'pending') AS pendingRisk
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sys_work WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.d, '%m/%d') AS label, IFNULL(ROUND(o.amt / 10000, 1), 0) AS value FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL n DAY) AS d FROM ( SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 ) nums ) t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(created_at) d, SUM(total_amount) amt FROM sys_order WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ) o ON o.d = t.d ORDER BY t.d ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.d, '%m/%d') AS label, IFNULL(ROUND(o.amt / 10000, 1), 0) AS value FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL n DAY) AS d FROM ( SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23 UNION ALL SELECT 24 UNION ALL SELECT 25 UNION ALL SELECT 26 UNION ALL SELECT 27 UNION ALL SELECT 28 UNION ALL SELECT 29 ) nums ) t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(created_at) d, SUM(total_amount) amt FROM sys_order WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ) o ON o.d = t.d ORDER BY t.d ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.d, '%Y-%m') AS label, IFNULL(ROUND(o.amt / 10000, 1), 0) AS value FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL n MONTH) AS d FROM ( SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 ) nums ) t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') d, SUM(total_amount) amt FROM sys_order WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') ) o ON o.d = t.d ORDER BY t.d ASC

SELECT w.title AS name, IFNULL(u.nick_name, CONCAT('user-', w.author_id)) AS author, DATE_FORMAT(w.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS submitTime, w.status FROM sys_work w LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = w.author_id WHERE w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.status IN ('pending','approved','on_shelf','off_shelf') ORDER BY w.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
